'''Sennegrin Coops''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Senneegrin Coops and [[Treezl Zillyons]] were originally part of a cut series of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' missions on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] that would have dealt with transferring supplies and Coops's corruption. Like several missions in Sobrik, the mission was cut before the game was launched, though Coops remained in the game.
